software.description: Anthropic's AI assistant app for conversations, writing and analysis.

evidence.claim: The policy lists categories of personal data collected, including identity and contact data such as name, email address and phone number at sign-up.

Personal data may be processed in aggregated or de-identified form to analyze and improve the Services, including analytics, research, studying user behavior and training AI models, as permitted by law.
Anthropic states it discloses personal data to, or receives it from, categories of third parties, beginning with affiliates and corporate partners; the policy's Recipients section has the full list.
Anthropic states it does not "sell" personal data as defined by applicable laws.
Users can opt out of sharing personal data for targeted advertising of Anthropic's own products, and Anthropic says it honors global privacy controls.

Inputs and Outputs may be used to train and improve Anthropic models unless you opt out in account settings; the policy says conversations flagged for safety review may still be used for model improvement even if you opt out.

Individual conversations can be deleted; they are removed from conversation history immediately and deleted from back-end systems within 30 days. Users can also request deletion of personal data, subject to exceptions.

Anthropic says conversation Inputs and Outputs may train its models unless you opt out in account settings (with stated exceptions such as safety review), and that it does not sell personal data. Individual conversations can be deleted.
